title: Mixed Unfitted finite element approximation of band structures in photonic crystals
summary: Photonic crystals are periodic dielectric structures whose optical properties are characterized by Maxwell eigenvalue problems with discontinuous material coefficients. For arbitrarily shaped inclusions, their numerical solution remains challenging due to costly mesh generation and remeshing as the geometry changes. In this paper, we address this challenge by developing a mixed unfitted finite element method based on the Floquet-Bloch transform.
